episodes.name: Steal My Sunshine
episodes.overview: With the threat of Jones behind them, in a peaceful Roswell we find Liz is busy teaching while Max lends an assist to his ex-partner on a string of recent bank robberies. Our couples are happy and thriving but a sudden storm, leaves everyone on edge about what is to come.

episodes.name: Fly
episodes.overview: A visitor connected to Liz's past comes bearing gifts. Anatsa digs in on a story about the bank heists, angering Max and putting Kyle and Isobel in a difficult position.

episodes.name: Subterranean Homesick Alien
episodes.overview: Liz, Max, Michael and Cameron put a plan into action that could finally get them a step closer to catching Bonnie and Clyde. Meanwhile, Maria is hiding her recent lack of visions and Kyle has a date.

episodes.name: Dear Mama
episodes.overview: Liz's work to find out more about a found skin sample hits a roadblock. Meanwhile, Michael continues to gain Bonnie's trust, but Clyde may not be as easily persuaded. Also, Isobel finally finds the courage to be honest with Anatsa and Maria suffers a devastating loss.

episodes.name: You Get What You Give
episodes.overview: Max's secrets may have a devastating outcome for Liz meanwhile, Maria helps Dallas in his search for answers and Michael makes an unsettling discovery about himself.

episodes.name: Kiss From a Rose
episodes.overview: Liz turns to Shivani for help finding scientific answers while Bonnie looks to Max for protection. Meanwhile, Kyle and Isobel deal with the fallout of their actions.

episodes.name: Dig Me Out
episodes.overview: Liz and Max have a major disagreement prompting her to turn to Rosa for guidance and Maria struggles to connect to her mother's spirit.

episodes.name: Missing My Baby
episodes.overview: With missing friends and mysteries abound, Liz returns to fringe science, but in working alongside her new mentor, she's confronted with an unsettling revelation and a difficult choice, meanwhile, Maria uncovers the truth behind the "messages" she's been receiving.

episodes.name: Wild Wild West
episodes.overview: After being exposed to her own "alien-power mist," Liz finds herself trapped in a fever dream and a battle to save not just her own life but Max's life as well. Meanwhile, Michael stumbles on a secret Rosa is keeping involving a surprising former adversary.

episodes.name: Down in a Hole
episodes.overview: Max and Rosa begin to uncover what Liz has been hiding, leading her to make a rash decision. Meanwhile, Michael and Maria struggle as their trail to locating their missing friends runs cold.

episodes.name: Follow You Down
episodes.overview: As Liz begins to see the error of her ways, she is quickly faced with a new threat which forces her to make a difficult decision. Meanwhile, Max finds himself in an intense standoff and Michael begins to lose hope of ever reuniting with Alex.

episodes.name: Two Sparrows in a Hurricane
episodes.overview: Liz is faced with an impossible decision, meanwhile Max agrees to join Isobel on a mission to save Bonnie.

episodes.name: How's It Going to Be
episodes.overview: Liz, doubting her abilities, calls for reinforcements, meanwhile Isobel shows Max a memory, one that will put him on a new trajectory and Michael makes a promise to Alex.
